title: Varicose Veins
subtitle: What varicose veins is, causes, risk factors, symptoms, evaluation, management, lifestyle considerations, and safety.
evidence_strength: Established evidence from clinical guidelines and systematic reviews supports the diagnosis, risk factors, and treatment options including compression therapy and endovenous ablation. Moderate evidence exists for pharmacological agents providing symptom relief. Emerging evidence concerns minimally invasive techniques and long-term outcomes. Safety profiles are well established for conservative measures; procedural risks require patient-specific evaluation.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
